extracted.intended_audience: NIH/US federal grant applicants, principal investigators, institutional grants administrators, and NIH program/grants staff who use eRA Commons/IMPAC II
extracted.subtask_description: Reference list of possible eRA Commons / IMPAC II application and award statuses with short descriptions and guidance about next steps or points-of-contact. Used to interpret the state of a grant application or award in NIH systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administratively Withdrawn by IC
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Application administratively withdrawn by funding agency. Administratively withdrawn: refer any questions to the Program Official. Administratively withdrawn by IC prior to review or council.

rubrics_metrics.name: Withdrawn
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Application withdrawn. Application withdrawn: refer any questions to the Scientific Review Administrator. Application withdrawn: previous application funded.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award terminated
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Award terminated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application withdrawn for amendment
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Application withdrawn by submission of amended/revised application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Awarded.  Non-fellowships only
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Application awarded. Award prepared: refer questions to Grants Management Specialist. Award prepared, not funded (appears as a separate status where applicable).

rubrics_metrics.name: Awarded.  Fellowships only
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fellowship awarded. Fellowship Award Cancelled (if subsequently cancelled).

rubrics_metrics.name: Pending Award.  Non-fellowships
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Non-competing award pending. Award prepared: refer questions to Grants Management Specialist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pending Award.  Fellowships only
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pending award status specific to fellowship applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Council - not recommended for consideration
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Council review completed: Application not recommended for further consideration. Refer any questions to Program Official.

rubrics_metrics.name: Council deferred
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Council review completed: Application deferred. Refer any questions to Program Official.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record Incomplete
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Application incomplete: refer any questions to the Scientific Review Administrator.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pending Council Review
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scientific Review Group review completed: Council review pending. Refer any questions to Program Official or Grants Management Specialist.

rubrics_metrics.name: SRG NRFC - Not considered by Council
rubrics_metrics.description: SRG NRFC - Not considered by Council
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scientific Review Group review completed: Application will not be considered by Council. Refer any questions to Program Official.

rubrics_metrics.name: No IRG Recommendation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No Scientific Review Group recommendation. Refer any questions to Scientific Review Administrator.

rubrics_metrics.name: IRG NRFC - Pending Council Review
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates IRG/IRG-level outcome not recommended for further consideration; pending any council-level actions. Refer questions to Program Official.

rubrics_metrics.name: SRG/Scientific Review Group review completed
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multiple variants appear: refer any questions to Program Official; may be followed by Council review pending, application unscored, application not recommended, or application will not be considered by Council. Specific guidance: refer questions to Program Official or Scientific Review Administrator as directed.

rubrics_metrics.name: SRG/Scientific Review Group review pending
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scientific Review Group review pending. Refer any questions to the Scientific Review Administrator.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unscored
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scientific Review Group review completed: Application unscored. Refer any questions to Program Official.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bottom Tier - Not considered by Council
rubrics_metrics.description: Bottom Tier - Not considered by Council
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Application placed in bottom tier and not considered by Council.

rubrics_metrics.name: Not considered - Application designated by IC for exclusion from review
rubrics_metrics.description: Not considered-Appl. designated by IC for excl. from review
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Application excluded from review: refer any questions to the Program Official.

rubrics_metrics.name: Withdrawn by IC - Previous Application Funded
rubrics_metrics.description: Withdrawn by IC - Previous Application Funded
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Application withdrawn: previous application funded. Refer questions to Program Official.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pending SRG Review
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scientific Review Group review pending. Refer any questions to the Scientific Review Administrator.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pending Award (noncompeting)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Non-competing award pending.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award prepared, not funded
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Award prepared: refer questions to Grants Management Specialist. Indicates administrative processing occurred but no funding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fellowship Award Cancelled
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fellowship was awarded then cancelled. Refer questions to Grants Management Specialist or Program Official as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scientific Review Group: Refer questions to Program Official / Scientific Review Administrator
rubrics_metrics.description: Scientific Review Group review completed. Refer any questions to Program Official.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When SRG review text includes this line, contact the named official for details about review outcomes, scoring, or next steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: To be Paid
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates award/payment is scheduled. Contact Grants Management Specialist for payment questions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application received
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Application received. For questions, refer to Program Official. This is an initial intake/receipt status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ineligible
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Application ineligible: refer any questions to the Program Official.

rubrics_metrics.name: Not Awarded / Not Awarded
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Application was not awarded. Refer questions to Program Official for appeals or resubmission guidance where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pending
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Application pending. For specifics on what is pending (review, council, award), refer to Program Official or Grants Management Specialist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Not Applicable
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Application not applicable: refer any questions to the Program Official.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pending administrative review
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pending administrative review. Refer any questions to Program Official or Grants Management Specialist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application excluded from review
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Application excluded from review: refer any questions to the Program Official.
